name: HZ_ORIG_SYS_MAPPING
description: The HZ_ORIG_SYS_MAPPING table stores the mapping among source systems and owner table names. Source systems are legacy or other systems that provide data for TCA tables, or the owner tables.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Source system name

columns.name: OWNER_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: TCA tables that map to the source system entities

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: A for Active. The source system can insert data into specific TCA tables.I for Inactive. The source system cannot insert data into specific TCA tables.The default is A for Active.

columns.name: MULTIPLE_FLAG
columns.description:
Y or N to indicate whether an source system reference can map to multiple OWNER_TABLE_ID columns or not..Defaults to N.
This column is not used in Fusion V1.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY_MODULE
columns.description: TCA Who column
